recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned portrait featuring a central figure in a pinstripe jersey, with a soft-focus collage of childhood faces layered into the background on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp foreground subject versus soft-focus background montage
Monochromatic sepia palette unifying disparate image layers
Vertical pinstripe patterns echoing the verticality of the composition
Handwritten script typography contrasting with blocky jersey numbering
coreInvariants: Uniform sepia color grading across all elements
Side-profile orientation of the primary subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered-left, shown from the waist up in a three-quarter back profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, high-contrast profile of the man's face and braided hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sharp profile, move down the pinstriped back, then drift right into the faded childhood portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, balanced by the ghosted imagery on the right.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; value range is compressed to emphasize texture and mood over clarity.

letterConstructionRules: Upper-left text: Fluid, monolinear cursive with a distinct tilt
Jersey text: Heavy, sans-serif block capitals with uniform stroke width
characterSpecificRedesigns: The numeral 1 features a large, flat base and a sharp, angled top serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic script paired with rigid, geometric athletic numbering.

preserve: The cursive style of the top-left text
The blocky nature of the jersey text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, handwritten feel of the top-left text
Matches the athletic aesthetic of the jersey numbering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned portrait of a man with braids in a pinstripe jersey, profile view. On the right side, blend in three faded, low-opacity portraits of children's faces. Apply a heavy film grain and a warm brown color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a handwritten signature-style script in the top left corner and a bold block numeral 1 on the back of the jersey using a dark charcoal color.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Are the background faces sufficiently transparent and soft-focus?
Is the film grain texture visible across the entire image?
Does the cursive text look like a natural signature?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any brand logos on the jersey
The exact signature to avoid identity duplication

mustAchieve: Clear separation between foreground and background layers

postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending of the background montage
Ensure the pinstripes follow the contours of the jersey
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across all elements
Confirm the grain doesn't obscure essential facial details
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Tone + Pinstripe Subject + Ghosted Background Montage + Script/Block Type Contrast
